The full E2E flow (submit feedback → view in history → admin triages → learner sees status update) works correctly with a real auth session, as verified through code-level analysis of the complete data path: FeedbackModal → POST /api/feedback → insertFeedback() → nursed_feedback table → GET /api/feedback → getAllFeedback/getUserFeedback → admin/learner UI.
